name: python-dev
description: Task-driven Python development toolkit: project scaffolding (devstart or uv), acceptance tests with pytest-bdd, GenAI components (pydantic-ai, dspy, FastMCP), data and database engineering, classical NLP, TUIs, refactoring, and SIFT quality audits. Routed by the `pythonista` orchestrator, which dispatches 5 phase subagents (specifier, implementer, cleaner, hardener, verifier) that run uv-based quality gates.
